evidence.dom: 10-K FY2025(alle-20251231.htm) Item1 Industry and Competition: 『The security products markets are highly competitive and fragmented throughout the world, with a number of large multi-national companies and thousands of smaller regional and local companies. This high degree of fragmentation primarily reflects local regulatory requirements and highly variable end-user needs. We believe our principal global competitors are Assa Abloy AB and dormakaba Group. We also face competition in various markets and product categories throughout the world, including Fortune Brands Innovations, Inc. in the North American residential market and from private label brands. As we move into more technologically advanced product categories, we may also compete against new, more specialized competitors.』 Item1A『The markets in which we operate include a large number of participants, including multi-national, regional and small, local companies. ... we compete with our retail customers and technology partners who use their own private labels.』。**自社シェア%の開示なし／上位N社合計シェアの開示なし**——原本に数値が無いため70/85/100は主張不能。しかも提出書類自身が『**fragmented** throughout the world』『**thousands of** smaller regional and local companies』『private label brands(同等品を多数が製造可能)』と**構造的に分散**を明言しており、自社シェア40%以上・上位2社≥80%・上位3社≥80%はいずれも定義上ありえない → 市場構造=競争(<40%)＝刻み50。Assa Abloy/dormakabaは『principal global competitors』の実名列挙であって上位3社合計シェアの開示ではない点に注意(旧dom=70はこれを寡占と読み違えていた)。Allegion Americas/Allegion Internationalとも同一記述で全社が同じ刻みに落ちるため50を確定(v9.9.41規約1・3)
evidence.moatW: 製品別売上(FY2025・純売上4,067.3百万USD): Mechanical products 2,713.9百万USD=66.7% / Electronic products 1,075.1百万USD=26.4% / Service 278.3百万USD=6.8%。報告セグメントは地理区分で Allegion Americas 3,218.8百万USD=79.1% / Allegion International 848.5百万USD=20.9%。顧客集中は原本に『Our 10 largest customers represented approximately 26% of our total Net revenues in 2025. No single customer represented 10% or more of our total Net revenues in 2025』『In fiscal years 2025, 2024 and 2023, no customer exceeded 10% of consolidated Net revenues』（出典: 10-K FY2025 (alle-20251231.htm) Schedule of Revenue by Product (R108) / Summary of Operations by Reportable Segments (R106)）→ 機械錠と電子錠は同一の仕様指定チャネル・同一顧客基盤に乗り、地理2セグメントも同一製品＝堀はセキュリティ開口部(ドアハードウェア)1本。最大顧客<10%かつ最大製品ライン66.7%<70% → moatW=70
